summary: R1 accepted for local workspace: paginated workspace-scoped listing and SQLite local runner persistence. Worktree and main type-check, full test run with maxWorkers=1 (95 passed/1 skipped files; 354 passed/27 skipped tests), and build passed. Initial default-worker run lost a worker; full serial retry passed without reducing coverage. New tests cover HTTP queries and process restart. Not production auth/database readiness.
